name: skill-radar
description: A pane listing every slash command and skill you have installed, grouped and re-ranked live by what you are working on. Press a row to drop it into the prompt with its arguments as placeholders.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts (Claude Code only seats an unasked pane from 144 columns; /radar opens it at any width)

includeBuiltins.title: Include built-ins
includeBuiltins.description: List Claude Code's own commands (/compact, /clear, ...) as well as yours. Toggle in the pane with b.

groupBy.title: Group by
groupBy.description: plugin: one group per plugin, plus Your commands and MCP. source: Plugins, Your commands, MCP, Built-in. flat: one ranked list.

rankMode.title: Ranking
rankMode.description: heuristic: free, instant, keyword and domain overlap only. hybrid: the heuristic plus one small model call after each turn that re-ranks the top of the list (uses your plan or API key).

rankModel.title: Ranking model
rankModel.description: Model alias or id for the hybrid re-rank, e.g. haiku

maxRows.title: Rows shown
maxRows.description: How many commands the pane lists before folding the rest (toggle with a to show all)

usedPenalty.title: Used penalty
usedPenalty.description: How far a command drops after it has been used this turn or last, 0 to 1 (0.3 drops it about a third)

nudge.title: Nudge Claude
nudge.description: On each prompt, tell Claude which of your skills look relevant (text only Claude reads). This is the setting that makes Claude reach for skills on its own.

suggest.title: Suggest after turns
suggest.description: After each turn, propose the top command as the dim Tab-to-accept suggestion in the prompt box

band.title: Band above prompt
band.description: Also show the top three as 1/2/3 buttons above the prompt. A digit typed alone into an empty prompt presses one.
